answer: Each claim is a thread spun only from my own verified jobs, tied at dawn to the public ledger; the thread must climb to its zenith, a peer-read apex where three independent jurors confirm the same ledger line, before the claim counts. Spinning costs 45 POA per claim, burned on use. A copied thread frays at dawn: its fibers never reach the zenith, the apex check fails, and the claim drops. Threads are non-lendable, so 100 clones need 100 true threads and 4,500 POA.
